181)༄༅/mnga' bdag nyang gi zab gter rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi las byang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes bya ba ni dmigs rim legs bshad skya rengs dang po ba

tei:div.tei:p: 181)༄༅/ mnga' bdag nyang gi zab gter rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi las byang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes bya ba ni dmigs rim legs bshad skya rengs dang po bzhugs// 181) (grub sprul/) (182)rgyal kun ngag gi dbang phyug che// mi yi ba rdzul rab bzhugs nas// thub dbang gnyis pa'i gar mdzad pa// kun mkhyen bla ma rgyal gyur cig /dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa'i khros pa'i zhal// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i ljags dang zla ba 'bum// tshes 'dra'i mche bar nad gdon bdud bgegs tshogs// nyil nyil gtub byed hya gṛ war 'dud// gang gi sgrub thabs bye ba'i phul// bod yul sa 'og gter gcig ma// mnga' bdag nyi ma 'od zer bton// gter bdag gling pas khrigs chog mdzad// de nyid rgyun gyi nyams len gyi// dmigs rim go sla gtsor bton nas// 'bri la 'khrul pa mchis srid na// lha dang bla mas bzod par bzhes// 'dir dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i dgongs pa rta skad thegs gsum gyis bstan te/ dang po gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa/ gnyis pa thabs grol lam gyi zab mo'i ting 'dzin sgom pa/ gsum pa byang phyogs so bdun gyis mthar thug gi 'bru tshe 'dir 'grub tshul bcas gsum po man ngag gi nges pas rgyun gyi nyams len dang sbyar nas 'chad pa la/ dang po thun gyi sngon 'gro lus gnad bcos pa ni/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs na rtogs pa sems la 'char/ zhes gsungs pas (183)rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs dong rtsai ltar brtsegs/ dpung pa lhod de brgyang*/ mgrin pa en tsam dgug lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtser phab pa ste lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan par bya/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal ba'i tshe/ rang gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags sgom skyon bying rmugs 'thib gsum thams cad rlung nag po'i rnam par phyir sangs kyis 'gro bar bsam la rlung ro g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas gsum mam dgu 'bud/

sems gnad kun slong bcos pa ni/ rang gi sems kha nang du log nas/ rang rgyud la brtags dgos te/ mi zhig yin nas bzung mi dge ba'i chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rtog pa dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtog pa/ nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems ste/ rtog pa de gsum ma gtogs skye mi shes pas/ mi dge ba'i rtog pa la 'jigs skyob kyi kun slong dang*/ legs smon gyi kun slong gnyis las/ dang po tshe 'di'i nad gdon/ rgyal po'i chad pa dang mu ge'i 'jigs pa sogs skyob pa'i ched du bsam nas sgrub na/ 'jigs pa de dag skyob na ma gtogs 'bras bu gang yang med pas spang dgos/ legs smon gyi kun slong ni/ chos sgrub pa 'di rnyed bstod snyan (184)grags/ tshe 'di'i zas gos gnas mal sogs kyi bde ba thob pa'i ched du bsam pa ni mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng ba yin pas kun slong de gnyis kyis chos la brten nas 'jig rten sgrub pa yin pas/ mnyam med dwags pos/ chos chos bzhin du ma spyad na/ chos kyis slar ngan song du 'gro ba'i rgyu byed gsungs pa dang*/ blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral las/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ zhes gsungs pa yin pas dug ltar spong*/ lung ma bstan gyi kun slong ni/ dge sdig gang yang gtad so med pa'i kha ton zhig 'don dar ba rtsam gyis sgrub pa de yin pas des kyang thar pa'i lam sne zin pa las lam la zhugs pa'i go mi chod pas blo de yang dge ba la bcos dgos/ dge ba'i kun slong la gsum las/ skyes bu chung ngus ngan song gsum ni sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin par shes pas de las thar nas mngon mtho lha dang mi'i lus rten 'thob 'dod kyi bsam pas dge ba sgrub na 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ zhes gsungs so// skyes bu 'bring pos srid pa rigs drug po sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul 'khor/

me'i 'aubs/ srin mo'i gling*/ spu gri'i so/ dug sbrul gyi tshang lta bu'i rang bzhin du shes nas 'khor ba las thar nas rang nyid kho na thar pa dam pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pas sgrub na zhi ba (185)nyan rang gi lam yin pas/ de yang phugs gtug na rang 'dod gtso bor sgrub pa'i lugs yin pas bsam pa de lta bus chos theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa sgrub mi rung ste/ rang don la zhen na sems bskyed min/ zhes so// de sngon rang 'dod phug tu bcug nas sdug bshal 'ba' zhig bsgrub pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin pas/ da ni rang 'dod yid byed kyi rtog pa yul phud rjes 'don byas nas/ gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems kho na don du gnyer nas sgrub pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i yon tan la bsam nas/ dus de ring gi nyi ma nas rang 'dod yid byed kyi bsam pa rgyud la skye mi bcol bar gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems kho na rgyud la skye ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa skyes bu chen po'i kun slong yin pas/ de rgyud la skye bar byed pa la/ dang po rang gi lus bskyed pa'i rtsa ba'i ma la bsgom/ de nas rim gyis nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tu sgom dgos pas/ 'di ltar nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyis khyab/ sems can gyis gar khyab las snang sdug bsngal gyis khyab/ las snang sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa'i sems can thams cad thog med nas da lta'i bar du dgra gnyen 'brel 'dris su ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ de'i nang nas snying nye ba'i dbang gis ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ rgyu mtshan ci yin na 'khor ba la thog ma zhes bzhag (186)tu med pas na da lta'i bar du 'khor bar 'khyams 'khyams pas sa lag mthil tsam gyi steng na yang*/ lan grangs mang por skye ma myong ba/ lan grangs mang por 'chi ma myong ba med pas dmyal ba dang lha phal cher ma gtogs ma med par mi skye bas rang gi ma gcig pus kyangalan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par ma byas/

de bzhin du pha skor gyi gnyen/ ma skor gyi bshes/ sde dgon/ yul grongs mthar nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can sna nas dbugs rgyu ba zhig yod phyin chad thams cad ma byas/ de yang thengs gcig ma yin par lan grangs mang por ma byas pa'i tshul yang yang bsam pas sems can thams cad ma yin/ nga bu yin pas bus ma la gnod bskyal thabs med pas thams cad ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan rigs pas dpyad nas bsgom/ lung las kyang ma yin par gsungs pa las/ min tshul gsungs pa bka' dgongs 'grel thams cad na med/ de mar shes pa yin/ drin dran pa ni/ da lta'i ma 'di la mtshon na/ rang dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam shes 'khyams po de ma'i mang la du zhugs nas zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar du/ sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad/ ma'i lus kyi bcud dang kha zas kyi dwangs ma lte ba nas brgyud de lus bskyed sring*/ phyir btsa' ba'i dus shi ba yin na dbugs ma chad/ gson po yin na mgo mi theg pa'i nya re nyo re ba de/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/ 'dzum (187)pa'i mig gis bltas/ snyan pa'i ngag gis bos/ zas kyi phud byin/ gos kyi rtses g.yogs/ shin tu byams pas bskyed sring bas lus bskyed pa'i drin/ srog byin pa'i drin/ yo byad bstab pa'i drin/ 'jig rten bstab pa'i drin rnams 'jig rten phyogs nas dran pa dang*/ chos kyi phyogs nas lus rten 'di bskyed/ dang po byang chub tu semasabaskyed pa/ bar du rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob pa/ mthar gzhan don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ da lta'i chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad ma sems can la brten nas 'byung ba'i drin rnams dran/ drin gzo 'dod ni/ de sngon ma sems can gyis/ khe dang rgyal kha thams cad bu nga la byin/ gyong dang bub kha thams cad ma rang gis blangs ba yin pas/ da ni ma sems can gyi skyid sdug la rang gis blta dgos pas/ de dag gis bde ba kho na 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu mi sgrub/

sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang sdug bsngal kyi rgyu 'bad med du sgrub pas/ 'bras bu bsdug bsngal bden pa nang gdon rkyen bgegs kyis dngos su gnod/ kun 'byung bden pa mi dge bas ma 'ongs brgyud nas gnod pas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pa/ 'bras bu khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig ces smon pa dang 'brel ba/ bral na ci ma rung zhes 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ bral ba zhig ngas bya zhes dam bca' dang 'brel ba ste/ 'brel ba gsum ldan dang*/ ma (188)/semasacan thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral ba zhig skyabs bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum po khyed mkhyen snyam du gsol ba gdab/ de ni zur dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa yin/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas bde ba gang la bkod na/ mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba ni srid pa'i mtha' dang*/ nyan rang gi go 'phang ni zhi ba'i mtha' yin/ mtha' de gnyis las 'das pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob par bya bsam pa shes rab kyis rdzogs byang la dmigs pa ste/ de gnyis po 'bras bu la dam bca' ba smon pa sems bskyed do// de'i ched du lam bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis la gzhol ba sogs dge rtsa ci 'dra ba zhig bsgrub dgos kyang bdag kho nas bsgrub par bya/ da lta bdag la nus pa med pas/ dang por sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub nas rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ thugs rjes gzhan sems can thams cad la grol nas grol ba'i lam bstan te 'gro ba'i don rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ rgyun ring ba ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dang rig pa 'dzin pa gong ma rnams kyis skal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du sgrub pa thams cad bdag gis dus snyigs ma skad cig ma gcig la sgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa rgyu la dam bca' ba 'jug pa sems bskyed de/

de dag ni bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub sems bskyed yin pas (189)dge rtsa thabs kyis zin pa sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa zhes bya'o// bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor padma dkar po 'buṃ phrag brdal ba ze'u 'bru dmar ser rgyas pa'i steng du seng khri dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rab byung ngam/ sngags pa gang yin pa'i cha lugs ji lta ba bzhin gsal ba la bla ma nyid kyi thugs ye shes chen po rtogs rung ma rtogs rung ngo bo ye dag gi sangs rgyas yin/ thugs sangs rgyas yin na sku sangs rgyas yin pas bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa dang*/ sku thugs gnyis ka sangs rgyas yin na gang mdzad pa thams cad sangs rgyasakyi mdzad par shes pa dang*/ rang ngor sangs rgyas las bka' drin che bar shes pa dang*/ bka' drin can gyi bla ma de skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi spyi gzugs yin par shes pa dang*/ de ltar shes nas gsol ba btab na lam rkyen gzhan la rag ma las par rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la btsan thabs su skye bar shes pa dang lnga'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas thugs brtse ba chen pos 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la/ 'das pa'i rjes mi 'brang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa 'phro mi mthud par ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog/ de dag ni thun gyi sngon 'gro yin/ de nas cho ga'i sngon 'gro la/ rnam rtog gcig ldang ba dang mnyam du/ rang nyid skad cig gis chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin rta mgrin nag po'i sku ru lam gyis (190)gsal ba'i thugs srog las 'od zer mu med par 'phros pas/ khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par gang ba'i tshogs zhing gsal btab pa'i mdun du/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas/

sangs rgyas dkon mchog la ston par zhu/ de las gzhan pa'i ston pa mi btsal/ chos dkon mchog la lam du khas blang*/ de las gzhan lam log par mi brten/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su khas blang*/ gzhan mi dge ba'i grogs mi bsten/ blo pha la mi 'dri/ gros ma la mi byed/ blo thag rang gis mi bcad/ mtho btang dma' btang skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang dkon mchog rang mkhyen/ dkon mchog gsum gyis skyab tu gsol/ thugs rje bzung du gsol snyam pas skyabs 'gro'i tshig lan gsum brjod pas/ tshogs zhing rnams kyis thabs yin no gsungs/ rang gis legs so brjod par mos pas skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa bzung bas skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya/ 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre mi dang mi min la phyi ma'i skyabs gnas mi bzung*/ sems can thams cad la gnod 'tshe'i rigs rang gi srog la bab kyang 'dzom/ sdig pa'i grogs dang yun ring mi 'grogs/ sku gzugs satstsha chag dum yan dang*/ yi ge 'bru gcig yan dang*/ dge 'dun pa ser gos gyon pa yan chad la gus pa (191)bskyed/ srog gi phyir yang dkon mchog rin po che mi spang*/ rgyal srid phyir yang mi spang*/ nad gdon rkyen bgegs sogs dgos gal ji ltar che yang dkon mchog las gzhan pa'i thabs mi tshol/ ci za ci 'thung phud kyis mchod/ nya stong sogs la mchod pa/ rgyun du dkon mchog la blo gtad nyag cig bya ba/ spyod lam bzhir dkon mchog gsol gdab yid byed dang mi 'bral bar byas pas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyur tshud cing*/ yon tan thams cad kyi rten gzhir 'gyur ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas so// de ni skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa bzung ba yin/ de nas sems bskyed kyi sdom pa blang ba'i slad du tshogs zhing sngar ltar gsal ba'i mdun du/ sngon gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas smon pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ 'jug pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bzung nas sems can gzhan gyi don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa bzhin du/

bdag gis kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rjes su zhugs te smon pa sems bskyed/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya rnams rim par ci nus su 'bad snyam pas sems bskyed kyi tshig lan gsum brjod pas/ bdag gi rgyud la sems bskyed kyi sdom pa thob/ mi'i srid pa don dang ldan/ lha dang bcas pa'i mchod sdong rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' nyid du bdag gyur pas/ da ni rang 'dod yid byed kyi bsam pas tshe 'di phyi kun tu rang don rtsa ba nas mi (192)bsgrub/ sems can gzhan thams cad gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi bde ba 'byung thabs 'ba' zhig la brtson pa lhur blangs te/ pha bsad pa'i shan pa lag dmar de dang 'phrad kyang ngas gnod len mi byed par ma zad phan pa cir 'gyur sgrub par bya'o bsam pa yang yang skyed/ des theg chen lam gyi gzhi tshugs pa yin/ tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa ni/ rang gi lus zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed ltar sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ dngos su 'byor ba dang*/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i tshogs thams cad la gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa bya ba dang*/ 'khor 'das kun kyi dge ba la dga' zhing phrag dog med pa'i rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas chos mi gsung bar bzhugs pa la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ gdul bya'i log sgrub kyi rkyen gyis sku mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa la bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ dge rtsa gzhan don du sngon gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rjes su slab ste yongs su bsngo ba ste yan lag bdun/ so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa dam tshig thams cad rang gi rgyud la bzung nas/ gnang bkag gi mtshams las mi 'da' bar rim par ci nus su bzung bar bya'o snyam pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la ma yin par snyam pa'i btang snyoms/ sdug bsngal bral 'dod snying rje/

bde ba (193)ldan 'dod byamasapa/ gnas skabs bde ba dang mi 'bral ba'i dga' ba rnams la blo sbyang zhing*/ mthar tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs thams cad dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas rang gi snying dbus su thim pas thugs rgyud kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam mo// de nas 'gal rkyen bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rang nyid rta mgrin nag por gsal bzhin pa'i thugs ka nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros/ gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin dri ma 'bag rtsog ma dag pa'i cha thams cad mes bsregs/ rlung gis gtor/ chus bkrus te stong par sbyangs/ stong nyid ngang las rten 'byung gi snang ba 'gag pa med par 'char pa'i yi ge bhrum̐ zhig byung*/ de nyid rin po che'i snod rgya nam mkha'i mtha' ltar yangs pa/ dpang ri rgyal bas mtho ba'i nang du gtor rdzas kyi dngos po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rtsa ba'i ro drug la nang gsais drug res sum cu so drug te lces myong ba dang*/ lte bar zhu ba dang*/ zhu rjes smin pa/ so sor so drug res brgya dang brgyad de ro brgya/ der nus pa'i bye brag bcu re ste nus pa stong dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po mgron rnams gang la gang 'dod kyi zad pa med pa'i longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen por byin gyis brlabs la/ gsang ba gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du blta nyan mi dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad skad cig la bkug nas de dag gis gtor ma'i rdzas la rol bas ngoms shing (194)tshim nas bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes nas rim gyis chos theg pa chen po thun min rdo rje theg pa'i skal pa dang ldan par bsam/ 'ga' zhig rnams re zhig skal ba dang mi ldan pa rnams ni gtor mas tshim nas bdag gi gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du 'du bar mi 'os pa rnams dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i rigs rnams gtor ma la zan/

chang bus lam rgyags/ ting los lam sgron gyis la mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol du phyir dengs shig gal te bden pa'i tshig la mi nyan/ bsgo ba'i bka' la mi rtsi ba'i rigs mchis na/ bdag nyid khro bo'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rang rtsal rdo rje la sogs pa mtshon cha'i char dang*/ khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas bgegs tshogs rnams dngangs/ bskrad/ brlag par byas nas gnas gzhan du phyir bskrad par mos pas bgegs bskrad kyi tshig brjod/ rdo rje me mtshon khro tshogs thams cad 'dus pa las rdo rje la sogs pa'i gur khang ste/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin gur phub pa lta bu'i steng rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis spras pa/ nang du rdo rje'i bla re bres pa/ khor yug phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ thams cad kyang gyen 'greng*/ phred rgyug sna tshogs pa/ rdo rje phra mos bar gsang med par gtams pa/ mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i zhun 'thas pa/ phyi rol thams cad mtshon cha sna tshogs pa dang me ris gtams pa/ bskal (195)pa'i rlung yang mi thar ba/ rdo rje 'dzin pas glags mi rnyed pa'i gur khang du gyur par bsam la srung 'khor gyi tshig brjod/ mthun rkyen byin dbab cing mchod rdzas brlab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis bskul nas 'og min chos kyi dbyings nges pa lnga ldan rtag pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gzhi dang rgyan dang dbyibs dang bkod pa tshad med pa'i zhing dang*/ sku dang ye shes mchod rdzas su shar ba thams cad spyan drangs nas sgrub rdzas dang gnas la thim/ gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i yon tan dang byin rlabs ma lus pa bdag la thim par mos la byin 'bebs kyi tshig brjod/ de ltar thim pas gnas phun tshogs 'og min zhing du bsgyur/ mchod rdzas rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho dang gnyis su med par bsgyur/ khyad par du rdo rje bde skyong gi snod du/

sman dang gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/ sha rnams kyang drod ma yal/ bdud rtsi rnams kyang rlangs pa ma yal ba/ de rnams kyang dug lnga 'joms pa'i rtsi/ nad lnga sel ba'i sman/ ye shes lnga grub pa'i rdzas/ chos nyid ngo bos grub pa/ nus pa'i mthus grub pa/ byin gyis brlabs pas grub pa/ de dag la skyob/ mu la bha dra/ tsandan smug po/ shing tsha/ gha la bha dra/ li shi/ gur guṃ/ dzā ti/ ga bur dang brgyad la/ chu las byung ba/ rlung (196)gis ded pa/ rtsi sman/ rdo sman/ sngo sman/ shing sman rnams dang*/ gshog pa can/ gdong pa can/ sder mo can/ mche can brgya re ste/ rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong sbyar ba dkyil 'khor bdun dang sbyor ba brgyad kyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi 'dod yon lnga'i phung po zad mi shes par brlab pa dang*/ rakta padma'i snod du khams gsum gyi 'dod chags thams cad bsdus nas khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po la/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i lha mo gi rti ma'i mkha' las rakta'i rgyun babs pa dang 'dres pa'i rakta'-i rgya mtsho chen po'i mos pa bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi go cha lta bu'i man ngag bsnyen cing sgrub pa la/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin sku bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ thog mar dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer stong pa chen po bsgom pa/ phyi nang snod bcud kyi dngos po thams cad rang sa/ rdul phran/ rdul phran cha med/ cha med rang bzhin med par gtan la phab pas 'khrul pa.a 'thas kyi bden zhen 'go pa'i phyir/ dngos po thams cad nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar dwangs pa'i ngang la sngar 'das bag chags kyi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs rnam rtog gi mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa rkyen yul du mi shor bar/ rang bab/ rang gnas/ yal song rjes med/ shar grol dus mnyam la bzhag pas/ tha mal gyi shes pa/ ma bcos pa'i rig pa/ blo bral gyi ye shes/ gnyug ma'i sems/ (197)shes pa'i bab/ yin lugs ji lta ba sems can sgrim pos ngan du ma bslad/

sangs rgyas sgam pos bzang por ma mdzad pa'i shes pa rang ga ma/ so ma/ gnyug ma/ phyal ba/ zang thal/ dwangs sa le ba/ khrig ge ba/ gsal seng nge ba/ sems la myong rgyu yod kyang*/ kha ru smra rgyu med pa/ yid la gsal rgyu yod kyang*/ 'di yin gtad so med pa/ yul gyi snang ba ma 'gags kyang*/ yul la 'dzin pa med pa/ rgya ma chad/ phyogs ma lhung*/ rtag pa med de ngo bo skye med stong pa/ chad pa med de rang bzhin 'gags med gsal ba/ stong bzhin gsal ba/ gsal bzhin stong pa nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su ma mthong gnyis med du mthong ba/ ma mthong ba'i mthong ba chen po/ gtad med rgya yan gyi shes pa ngang bzhag chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la/ yengs su skad cig kyang med la sgom du rdul tsam med pa/ de'i ngang skyangs nas bzhag pas gegs dang gol sa thams cad las rang grol/ rnam rtog thams cad rang shar rang grol du lam lam/ phan med gnod med du sangs sangs bzhag pa ni de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin yin/ gnyis pa snying rje (198)sgyu ma ni/ de lta bu'i stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la mar shes/ drin dran/ drin lan gzo 'dod/ sdug bsngal bral 'dod/ bde ba ldan 'dod rnams rgyud 'khul nges par sbyang*/ gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ stong pa'i gdangs/ snying rje'i rtsal ma 'gags pa rgyu'i yi ge bod yig hūm̐ mthing nag shin tu phra ba spus bris pa tsam/ 'od zer nyi ma 'bum dus gcig la shar ba tsam du yod par bsam/ de la dmigs pa rtse gcig bzung*/ sems bying na bstod/ rgod na phab/ g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin gyi nyams lnga ma rdzogs bar sbyangs/ de las 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i srung 'khor slar yang gsal brtan ches cher bskyed/ bskyed pa sku'i gzer rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ byang phyogs so bdun rdzogs pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/

bdag nyid gzhi lus kyi phung khams khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi skur lam gyis gsal ba ni/ dran pa tsam gyis rdzogs pa lta ba gyad kyi lha zhes bya/ zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par spyan gyi dkar nag tshun chad ma 'dres par rnam pa gsal ba/ chos sku nyag gcig mtshon pa'i zhal gcig gdul bya ma rung pa drag pos 'dul ba'i phyir spyan gsum bsgrad cing*/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ zhal gdangs/ ljags 'dril/ mche ba zla tshes lta bu bzhi gcogs pa/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub (199)pa'i rta mgo ljang gzhur/ rngog ma le brgan/ phur bu ser so/ gzhi lam 'bral bu'i don ston phyir rta skad lhang lhang 'tsher bas gza' klu rgyal bsen gnod byed thams cad 'dar yeng yeng*/ bsngangs shing skrag nas phyi rol rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad cing*/ phal cher dam 'og tu btsud/ thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i phyag gnyis kyis/ g.yas pas stong nyid ltang bas lta na tshar gcod pa'i ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs rje chen pos sems can rjes su bzung ba'i lcags kyus 'khor ba gnas nas 'dren pa/ srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa'i zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis gzung 'dzin chags sdang gi nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod phyir dgra bgegs pho mo byi chings su bsnol mar mnan pa/ 'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol phyir dar nag gi ber chen sku la gsol ba/ sku stod la zhing gi g.yang gzhi khrag 'dzag pa dang*/ sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga mtshon phyir thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse bran can dbu la gsol/ 'du byed lnga bcu dag pa'i thod rlon khrag 'dzag gi do shal 'phyang ba/ ma rig bag chags bsreg pa'i ba spu'i gseb nas me yi tsha tsha 'phro ba/ gzung 'dzin tshar gcod pa bskal pa'i me dpung chen po'i klong na bzhugs pa/ dbu ral gsigs pa'i gseb nas khro chung(200)char ltar 'bebs pa sogs rnam dag dran pa dang*/

de dag kyang chos nyid don gyi lha bla ma'i thugs ye shes chen po de nyid/ chos can rtags kyi gzugs skur bzhengs pa yin no snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed/ de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ la rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer me dpung rab tu 'bar ba ni/ tha mal gyi me las tsandan gyi me bdun 'gyur tshal/ tsandan gyi me las dus mtha'i me dang*/ de las dpyal ba'i me/ de las bdun 'gyur gyis tsha ba'i rang bzhin gyi me dpung chen pos lus phyi nang thams cad khyab pas/ tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis las mi dge ba bsags pa'i sdig pa des thar lam byang chub la sgrib pa dang*/ 'dod chags las nad rlung*/ zhe sdang mkhris pa/ gti mug bad kan gyi nad dang*/ zhe sdang pho gdon/('dod chags mo gdon/) gti mug klu gdon thams cad lhag med du bsreg/ me lce ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas phyi sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad me ri me dpung du gyur/ nang mi dang mi ma yin 'dre rgyal po btsan ma mo gdug 'dre dam sri shi 'dre gshed 'khyams thams cad la phog pas las snang sdug bsngal thams cad bsregs nas thams cad khro bo rta mgrin gyi skur gyur pas thams cad kyis sngags sgra sgrogs pa dang*/ thugs ye shes chen por gyur pas gnod byed gdon bgegs kyi ming yang med par bsam/ gzhan yang ma dang sring mo rnams g.yon du bsgom/ bu dang chung ma mdun du bsgom/ nor rdzas longs spyod rgyab (201)tu bsgom/ srung bya de thams cad kyi lus khro bo rta mgrin nag po rang dang 'dra ba bsgom/ de rnams kyi mgrin pa nas ngag gi dbang po yi ge āḥyi rnam pa can rtsa sngags la bstim/ snying ga nas rnam shes hrīḥyig gi rnam pa can thugs srog hūm̐ la bstim mo/ de ltar rang nyid khro bo'i dbang por gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ rta mgrin par āḥdamar po// snying gar hūṃ sngon po rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gyur par mos/

slar thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pas dbang bskur ba'i bdud rtsi'i chus lus kyi nang thams cad mer khrig gis gang*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba mgo bo'i gnas lngar so sor gyur pa las rigs lnga sprul sku'i cha byad can lnga'i dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa bya'o// spyan 'dren pa ni/ snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sngon gyi dam bca' dang thugs kyi rgyud drag tu bskul bas gzhal yas khang srung ba'i 'khor lo me ri dang bcas pa byon nas nam mkha'i khams gang bar bsam pas spyan 'dran gyi tshig brjod/ chu la chu bur thim pa ltar dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam la bzhugs gsol gyi tshig brjod/ snying ga nas tha mal pa'i lus spros pas sems can thams cad dang sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas phyag 'tshal bar mos la phyag 'tshal gyi tshig bklag nas mthar snying khar bsdu/ slar yang (202)snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchod rdzas kyi bye brag thogs pa dpag tu med par spros pa rnams kyis me tog spyan/ bdug spos shangs/ mar me phyag/ dri chab sku/ zhal zas ljags/ rol mo snyan la dbul ba dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos rnams dang*/ rin chen bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs mchod pa'i sprin phung mchod rdzas re re la'ang brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya grangs med par 'phro ba/ re re la'ang grangs med 'phro bas nam mkha'i thams cad khyab par 'gengs pas mchod pa dang*/ sman phud bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen po bzhes pas bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa dang*/ rakta khrag gi rgya mtsho la rol pas khams gsum gyi 'dod chags thams cad dag nas 'khor ba gnas stongs pa dang*/ gtor ma 'dod yon lnga'i sprin 'phro ba la lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi sbu gus drangs pas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du tshim par bsam pa dang bcas pa'i dgos pa/

mchod sprin spyir phul bas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ sman gyis dkar cha spyi bor dag pas sku rdo rje/ raktas dmar cha lte bar dag pas gsung rdo rje/ gtor mas shes rig mun pa can snying gar dag pas thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// slar snying ga nas 'jig rten na che ba tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ 'khor los bsgyur ba/ 'das pa na che ba rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros pa rnams (203)kyis lag tu pi waṃ la sogs pa'i sgra snyan pa'i rol mo'i tshogs 'khrol/ zhal nas chos nyid don rtags dang sbyar nas bstod pa'i tshig rnams brjod par mos nas bstod pa bya'o// mthar thams cad rang gi snying gar bsdu/ khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po sogs rgyal ba sras bcas kyis sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su thugs bskyed pa'i dam bca' gnad nas bskul te thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su dgongs par mdzod cig ces bskul ba dang*/ bzlas pa sngags kyi gzer ni/ thugs srog sngags phreng gis bskor ba la shes pa gtad pa zla ba skaraphreng gi 'dzab dgongs dang ldan pas rtsa sngags yi ge bcu gcig pa 'bum phrag bcu gcig gam/ 'bum phrag so gsum du bzla ba yin/ 'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer ni/ sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig lu gu rgyud du byung ba bying ba'i tshe mgrin pa'i lam nas sna bug g.yon pa nas phyir byung*/ rang gi lte ba nas nang du zhugs/ sngags phreng la g.yas bskor gyis bar ma chad du bskor ba dang*/ rgod pa'i tshe lte ba nas phyir byung*/ sna bug g.yas nas nang du bar ma chad par zhugs par bsam pa mgal mo'i 'khor lo lta bu'i 'dzab dgongs dang*/ 'od zer yar spros rgyal ba sras bcas la sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshur 'dus sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs/ mar spros sems can thams cad la phog

las snang sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad sangs sangs dag thams cad rta mgrin nag po'i go 'phang la bkod pa rgyal pos pho nya 'gyed pa'i 'dzab (204)dgongs rnams la bslab/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i rol par shes pas dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sngags sgra 'ur ti ri ri bzla bar bsam pa bung ba tshang zhig gi 'dzab dgongs rnams ni bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang*/ sgrub pa'i tshe phaṭa dzaḥ zhes pas mdun rten gyi gnas su dkyil 'akor gyi 'khor lo gnyis pa zhig gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal ba la 'od zer spro bsdu rnams sngar bshad pa ltar dang*// gnas gsum nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros pas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag/ lam bzhi sgom pa la dbang*/ gnas skabs 'bras bu rig 'dzin bzhi dang*/ mthar thug sku bzhi 'grub pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag par mos pa dang*/ las sbyor gyi dmigs pa dang sbrags ste bsnyen sngags las sngags sbrel mar bzla/ mtshon cha lta bu'i man ngag las la sbyor ba'i rgyun gyi dmigs pa ni/ srung 'khor gyi phyi rol gnam sa gnyis lcags sreg gi rang bzhin gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo kha sbyor bar yod ba'i nang du/ dgra gegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa rang dbang med par shugs kyis tshud de/ 'khor lo'i me lces tshur sreg/ nang gi srung zlog gi khro bo rnams las me 'bar/ rlung 'tshubs/ mtshon cha sna tshogs phyir 'phros pas gtub cing bsregs te thal ba bun bun gtor bar bsam la las sngags bzla'o// thun mthar mchod bstod dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra bas btang*/ dus bzang rnams su tshogs kyi mchod pa bya na/ tshogs rdzas rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin du bsam la/ tshogs (205)zhing rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad spyan drangs ba la mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod/ tshogs dang po 'dod yon lngī rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po la rol nas tshogs rdzogs/

bar pa bdag lus phung khams thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang lhan cig rol pas nyams chags nyes ltung dag par bsam pa dang*/ tha ma la/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi gzung 'dzin chags sdang thams cad bstim pa'i bsgral bya dngos su gsal ba la/ tshe bsod rang la bstim/ rnam shes dbyings su spar/ sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nyid sngon dpal chen po'i spyan sngar rnal 'byor pa'i lhag ma blang zhing phrin las sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i ma dang mkha' 'gro ging lang dbang phyug rnams kyis rol bar mos pa dang*/ bskul ba'i tshe/ sngon gyi thugs dam gnad nas bskul zhing thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' bzhin du bdag sgrub pa po la mchog gi dngos grub kha sbyor bdun ldan dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub phrin las bzhi/ grub pa brgyad sogs dang*/ gsang ba'i dgra gsum bsad/ 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi mnan/ bar chad kyi 'phrang gsum bsgral/ 'du ba gsum gyi rten 'brel sgrigs/ 'bar ba gsum gyi ye shes bskyed pa sogs gsol ba drag tu gdab cing*/ chad tho'i dus/ dpal chen po'i (206)spyan sngar bstan pa skyong bar khas blangs ba'i chos skyong pho rgyud/ mo rgyud/ ma ning gi sde/ 'das dang ma 'das pa'i srung ma rnams dang*/ brtan ma'i tshe/ khyad par du bod khams kyi so kha bsrung zhing mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i bstan ma chen mo rnams la rang rang gang la gang 'tshams pa'i gtor ma dgyes dgu'i sprin gyis brngan pas zhi sogs las rab 'byams thogs med du sgrub par mos pa'o// rta bro'i dus/ sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud bgegs thams cad srung 'khor gyi 'og sa rim pa dgu'i gting du byang chub kyi sems rgyud la ma skyes kyi bar thar med du mnan par bsam la gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa'i steng rdo rjes mnan cing rgyas gdab/ slar gtang rag gi mchod bstod sngar bzhin du bya'o/// 'di man rgyun du thun bsdu ba'i skabs sogs la yang dgos/

bdag gis bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i las byed pa la dgos pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang*/ cho ga'i yan lag rgyud don gyi dngos po bcu gcig ma tshang pas nyams pa dang*/ ma shes cing bag med pas thugs dang 'gal ba'i las ji ltar bgyis pa thams cad bzod pa dam par bzhes te chos dbyings gnyug ma'i klong du bzhag pas lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol zhes yig brgya tshar gsum 'don/ tshogs mgron gyi ye shes pa dang*/ mdun dkyil gyi ye shes pa rnams sku gsung thugs rten la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu'o// de yan gyis skye ba'i bag chags sbyang zhing dag sprul sku'i yon tan gzhi la rdzogs/ rdzogs rim zhi (207)lhag zung 'brel gyi smin byed du 'gro ba yin par nges shes bskyed/ gnyis pa 'chi ba lam byed chos sku'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis phog pas dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung 'khor la thim/ de yang gzhal yas khang la thim/ de yang gtso bo la thim/ de yang sngags phreng*/ de yang hūm̐ḥ zhabs kyu 'a chung*/ de yang ha khog/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de na da sum 'khyogs la thim par bsam te cung zad bzhag/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar mi dmigs pa'i ngang chos nyid bsam brjod dang bral ba'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag des 'chi srid dag/ chos sku'i yon tan rdzogs/ zhi gnas kyi smin byed du 'gro/ gsum pa bar do lam byed longs sku'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnam rtog gcig ldang ba dang lhan cig chu las chu bur brdol ba bzhin/ skad cig gis khro bo'i dbang po rta mgrin nag po'i sku lam gyis gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis ye shes lnga rdzogs par byas/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab kyis zhu lugs su g.yogs pas bar chad gdon bgegs byad phur rbod gtong mi mthun nyer 'tshes glags mi rnyed par bsam pa srung ba thams cad kyi rgyal po yin/

des bar do dag longs sku'i yon tan gzhi la rdzogs/ rdzogs rim lhag mthong gi smin byed du 'gro ba yin no// de yan chad kyi dmigs pa thams cad blo la gzhol ba na stong nyid kyis lta ba'i ngang mi shor ba dang*/ snying rje'i (208)rtsal ma nyams pas stong snying rje zung du 'brel bas dmigs pa'i rnam pa rnams la blo rtsal sbyangs pas srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa'i byang chub chen po sgrub pa'i dge rtsa yang dag par 'gyur ro// gsum pa dge rtsa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa 'jug bsngo ba dam pas rgyas gdab pa ni/ da lta thun bcad pa'i dge rtsa de nyid mtshon byed du byas te rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i zag med kyi dge rtsa/ sems can thams cad kyi zag bcas kyi dge rtsa/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum bsags dang bsog par 'gyur ba'i dge rtsa thams cad phyogs gcig tu dril nas/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te mi gnas pa'i myang 'das dpal chen rta mgrin nag po'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i phyir du/ stong nyid kyi gdangs bsngo ba'i rnam par shar ba 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi bsngo ba'o// sngon gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas sems can gzhan don du bsngo ba smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa'i rjes su slob ste bsngo bar bgyi'o/ de ltar bsngos pa'i mthus/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ bdag sogs chos sgrub pa po'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba/ mthun rkyen tshe dpal rgyas pa/ mthar thug sangs rgyas 'grub pa sogs ji ltar smon pa'i 'dod don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol ces smon pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshe/ nam mkha' gang ba'i rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis kyi tshig brjod/ me tog gi char dbab pas dge (209)legs kyi snang bas sa gsum kun tu khyab par mos pa'o// 'gro 'dug spyod lam kun tu khro rgyal rta mgrin nag po'i gsal snang dang ma bral bar bya/

snang grags rtog pa thams cad lha sngags chos sku dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i nges pa yang yang drangs/ tha mal gyi rtog pa skyes pa'i tshe de ma thag tu lha sngags kyi dran pas 'bur 'joms su gtong*/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa skyes pa'i tshe/ thams cad lha'i 'du shes drag tu skyed pas zhi/ zhe sdang skyes pa'i tshe/ thams cad ma'i 'du shes kyis bde sdug gtong len sogs 'bad pas zhi/ mdor na sgo gsum chos dang mthun pa'i spyod pa kho nas dus 'da' bar bya/ nub mo nyal ba'i tshe mgo byang du bstan/ gzhogs g.yas pa sar phab/ seng ge nyal stangs dang ldan pas de ring gi dus su bdag gis mi dge ba'i rtog pa ci dran/ las ngan ci bsags zhes mno bsam btang nas mi dge ba bsgrubs med na dga' ba sgom/ dge ba bsgrubs na bsngo ba bya/ mi dge ba bsgrubs 'dug na yig brgya mang du brjod/ bshags sdom drag tu bya/ snyom par zhugs pa'i skabs/ rang lus rta mgrin nag po'i dwangs ma 'od kyi lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan/ spyi bor haṃ yig bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin/ mar gyi sna rtser a shad me yi rang bzhin du bsam/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo'i gsal snang dang*/ mkha' gsang yab kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ yum gyi (210)mkha' padma 'dab ma brgyad par gsal/ thabs 'di la brten nas thabs byung bde ba'i ye shes bskyed par bya'o snyam pas 'du shes gsum gyi rol pas a shad las me 'bar/ haṃ yig bdud rtsir zhu/ spyi bo nas rim par babs pas yas babs rgyu'i dga' ba bzhi/ sna rtser bab sa/ rlung pho mo 'thab pas gyen du drangs pas mas brtan 'bras bu'i dga' ba bzhi po ngos bzung la thabs des drangs pa'i thabs byung rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du bzhag gnyid du 'gro ba dang rang nyid kyi lhar snang mtha' nas dbus su yal ba'i ngang la bsdus nas chos nyid kyi ngang skyong bzhin gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ nangs par ldang ba'i tshe/

mdun mkhar dpa' bo mkha' 'gros rol mo'i sgra dang glus gnyid las sad par bsam la/ rang nyid rta mgrin nag po'i skur lam gyis gsal bar bsam la sngar bshad pa bzhin thun la 'jug go/ de dag ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor lag len ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo// bsnyen mtshams la zhugs pa'i tshul dang*/ sgrub pa dang smad las sogs ni sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi gsung rabs dang*/ gtso bor rtsa ba'i gzhung la goms 'dris byas pas sgrub pa nyid do// de dag la brten nas gnas skabs lam gyur gyi 'bras bu rig 'dzin bzhi dang*/ mthar thug che mchog rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la 'di phyi bar do gang rung la sbyor nges pa ni 'bras bu yin no// rab dkar dge tshogs malli ka yi phreng*// bskyed rdzogs (211 212)bu mo'i rgyan du rab spras pas// mchog thun grub pa'i gzi mdangs rab rgyas nas// kun kyis ltad mo'i dga' ston nyid gyur cig /skye bar bla ma yi dam lhag pa'i lhas// rjes su bzung zhing sa lam myur du bgrod// mtha' yas skye rgu'i 'dod ster rol pa can// phan bde'i btsas su 'gyur ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i phrin las kyi gar mkhan chos srid lugs brgya'i mkhyen spyod mkha' ltar yangs pa mi rje lha'i sras po mda' dpon sne stod pa chen po tshe dbang rnam sras kyi thugs dam gsal 'debs su mang du thos pa'i rnying btsun padma nor bu'am dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis na phag ri khrod du gang dran thol byung du shar mar bris pas kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig //sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
